description.en: Plays a technique/skill cutscene ("waza") for the participants set up with CMND_INIT_SKILL_SCRIPT and CMND_SETUP_SKL_SQ_*, with options controlling evolution effects, success/failure outcome, and camera/fade behavior.
ID of the technique to play.
ID of the map to play the technique on.
Whether to play the technique's evolution/upgrade variant.
Whether to play the full production (cinematic) version.
Whether to mirror the map for this play.
Whether to auto fade out at the end.
Whether to suppress the technique-name telop caption.

Likely true once the technique cutscene was started; null if the call was invalid (fewer than 7 arguments). The success value is produced by an internal helper that wasn't fully traceable from the decompiled code.

example.code:
// Play a technique cutscene with the configured outcome and options
CMND_RUN_SKILL_SCRIPT(_wazaID, _mapID, _evolution, _production, _success, _mapReverse, _endAutoFade, _noTelop, _cmrCut);
